title.en: US Lifts Export Ban on Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 After 18 Days
title.zhHans: 美国解除对 Anthropic Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的出口禁令，历时 18 天

searchSummary.en: The US government lifted export controls on Anthropic’s Fable 5 and Mythos 5 on June 30, 2026, ending an 18-day global access ban. The first reversal of an AI export control order.
searchSummary.zhHans: 美国政府于2026年6月30日解除对 Anthropic Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的出口管制，结束了为期18天的全球访问禁令。这是首次逆转对 AI 模型的出口管制令。

summary.en: On June 30, 2026, the US Department of Commerce lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models, ending an 18-day global access ban that had begun on June 12. Anthropic announced that Fable 5 would return to global users on the Claude platform starting July 1, with a phased rollout including up to 50% of weekly usage limits through July 7. The reversal followed behind-the-scenes negotiations between Anthropic and the Trump administration. Critics noted that the ban had already accelerated the shift toward open-source AI alternatives, with Chinese lab Z.ai releasing GLM-5.2 under MIT license within 24 hours of the original ban.
summary.zhHans: 2026年6月30日，美国商务部解除了对 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 模型的出口管制，结束了始于6月12日、为期18天的全球访问禁令。Anthropic 宣布 Fable 5 将于7月1日起在 Claude 平台上恢复对全球用户的访问，采取分阶段推出方式，至7月7日前每周使用限额的50%可用。这一逆转发生在 Anthropic 与特朗普政府进行幕后谈判之后。批评者指出，该禁令已经加速了向开源 AI 替代方案的转变——中国实验室 Z.ai 在原始禁令发布后24小时内就发布了 MIT 许可的 GLM-5.2。

narrative.en: On June 30, 2026, the US Department of Commerce lifted export controls on Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5, ending the most dramatic standoff between an AI company and the US government to date. The export ban had been imposed on June 12, just three days after Fable 5's public launch, citing national security concerns under export control law. Anthropic had responded by disabling both models for all users worldwide. The 18-day ban triggered intense debate about AI export controls, with critics arguing it was overbroad and counterproductive. In a notable twist, the ban's removal was announced on the same day Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5 as its new default model. Anthropic confirmed a phased restoration: Fable 5 would return globally on July 1 on the Claude platform, with cloud platform availability following in phases. The model would count toward up to 50% of weekly usage limits through July 7 for Pro, Max, Team, and selected enterprise plans. The lifting of the ban was seen as a concession by the Trump administration amid pressure from the AI industry and enterprise customers who had lost access to Anthropic's most advanced models. However, WIRED reported that the lifting came with 'strings attached,' though the specific conditions were not disclosed. The rapid policy reversal — from ban to unban in 18 days — underscored the ad hoc nature of AI export control policymaking and raised questions about long-term regulatory stability.
narrative.zhHans: 2026年6月30日，美国商务部解除了对 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的出口管制，结束了迄今为止 AI 公司与美国政府之间最戏剧性的对峙。出口禁令于6月12日实施，距 Fable 5 公开发布仅三天，引用出口管制法下的国家安全关切。Anthropic 的回应是对全球所有用户禁用这两个模型。长达18天的禁令引发了关于 AI 出口管制的激烈辩论，批评者认为禁令范围过宽且适得其反。一个值得关注的转折是：禁令解除的公告与 Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5 作为新默认模型发生在同一天。Anthropic 确认了分阶段恢复：Fable 5 将于7月1日在 Claude 平台上全球恢复，云平台可用性将分阶段跟进。至7月7日前，该模型将计入 Pro、Max、Team 和特定企业用户每周使用限额的50%。此次禁令解除被视为特朗普政府在 AI 行业和失去 Anthropic 最先进模型访问权的企业客户压力下做出的让步。然而，WIRED 报道称解除禁令带有'附加条件'，具体条件未被披露。从禁令到解禁仅18天的快速政策逆转，凸显了 AI 出口管制政策制定的临时性，并引发了对长期监管稳定性的质疑。

text.en: The Department of Commerce lifted export controls on Fable 5 and Mythos 5 on June 30, 2026, ending an 18-day ban.
text.zhHans: 美国商务部于2026年6月30日解除了对 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 的出口管制，结束了为期18天的禁令。

text.en: Fable 5 access was restored globally on July 1 with phased limits through July 7.
text.zhHans: Fable 5 于7月1日恢复全球访问，至7月7日实行分阶段限额。

text.en: The rapid policy reversal (ban to unban in 18 days) revealed the ad hoc nature of AI export control policymaking and the government's lack of a coherent framework for regulating frontier AI models.
text.zhHans: 快速的政策逆转（18天内从禁令到解禁）揭示了 AI 出口管制政策制定的临时性，以及政府在监管前沿 AI 模型方面缺乏连贯框架。

text.en: Critics argued that even with the ban lifted, the uncertainty created by the 18-day disruption damaged enterprise trust in US AI platforms and accelerated customer evaluation of non-US alternatives.
text.zhHans: 批评者认为，即使禁令解除，18天的中断所带来的不确定性损害了企业对美国 AI 平台的信任，并加速了客户对非美国替代方案的评估。

description.en: First reversal of a US AI export ban establishes a pattern of regulatory volatility, creating uncertainty for enterprises building on US AI platforms and undermining the credibility of export controls as a policy tool.
description.zhHans: 美国首次逆转 AI 出口禁令，建立了监管波动的模式，给基于美国 AI 平台构建的企业带来了不确定性，并削弱了出口管制作为政策工具的可信度。

description.en: Ban lift restored access for enterprise customers and developers who depend on Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for production workloads.
description.zhHans: 禁令解除恢复了依赖 Fable 5 和 Mythos 5 进行生产工作的企业客户和开发者的访问权。
